faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheadline: Answers to the most important questions about supplement distribution in Denmark.
faq.q1: What is required to distribute dietary supplements in Denmark?
faq.a1: Dietary supplements in Denmark must be notified to the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration (Fødevarestyrelsen), comply with EU supplement regulations (Directive 2002/46/EC) and meet local labeling requirements in Danish. NordNutri.dk guides you through the entire process.
faq.q2: How long does it take to enter the Danish market?
faq.a2: The typical timeline is 2–4 months from first contact to market introduction – depending on product type and launch readiness. We optimize the process to minimize your time-to-market.
faq.q3: What are the main sales channels for supplements in Denmark?
faq.a3: The primary channels are pharmacies, grocery chains such as Bilka, Netto and Coop, specialty stores, sports chains and e-commerce platforms. We have relationships across all these channels.
faq.q4: Does NordNutri.dk handle inventory management and logistics?
faq.a4: Yes. We offer full logistics support including warehousing, order handling and delivery to distribution partners and end customers across Denmark.
faq.q5: How much does it cost to cooperate with NordNutri.dk?
faq.a5: Our pricing is tailored to the specific cooperation and depends on product volume, scope of services and market strategy. Contact us for a free, no-obligation conversation.
faq.q6: Can NordNutri.dk help with Danish product labeling?
faq.a6: Absolutely. We assist with correct Danish translation and labeling in compliance with Danish Food Administration requirements and EU regulations.
faq.q7: What is the minimum order volume?
faq.a7: We work with manufacturers of all sizes and adapt minimum order volumes to your capacity and our market strategy. Contact us to discuss your specific needs.
faq.a8: We can offer exclusive distribution agreements for markets and product categories – depending on brand and business model. Details are agreed individually.
